name: Rating
description: Stars for giving a score, such as rating a template, or for showing one, such as an average of 4.5 out of 5. Interactive ratings are a radio group; read-only ratings can show halves.
whenToUse: To let people score something on a short scale, e.g. "Rate this template".
To show an average score next to products, reviews or templates.

whenNotToUse.text: To pick a number from a wide range.
To show progress toward a goal.

anatomy.name: Stars
anatomy.description: One star per score; filled stars show the rating.

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.description: The number after the stars, e.g. "4.5".

values.meaning: In lists, cards and table rows.
For a dedicated rating form or review dialog.
Shows a score, including halves, without letting people change it.
Adds the number after the stars.

states.name: Not rated
states.meaning: No score chosen yet; all stars are empty.

states.name: Rated
states.meaning: Stars up to the score are filled.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: Previews the score up to the star under the pointer.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: Shows keyboard focus on the current star.

states.name: Read only
states.meaning: Shows a score that cannot be changed.

behavior.text: Clicking a star sets the score to it. Arrow keys move the score up and down.
Pass value and onValueChange to control it, or defaultValue to let it manage its own state.
Read-only ratings fill stars partly, so 4.5 shows four and a half stars.
Stars run from the right in Arabic, and partial stars fill from the right.

content: Name what is rated in the label: "Rate this template", not "Rating".
Show the number next to read-only stars when exact values matter.
Translate starLabel and summaryLabel in other languages.

guidelines.do: Give the rating a label that says what is rated.
guidelines.why: Screen readers announce the label as the group name.

guidelines.do: Use read-only stars with the value for averages.
guidelines.dont: Use interactive stars to show someone else’s score.
guidelines.why: Interactive stars invite a click that would change the score.

guidelines.do: Keep the scale at five stars.
guidelines.why: Long scales are slow to scan and hard to hit on touch screens.

accessibility.role: radiogroup of native radio inputs; read-only ratings are role="img" with a summary.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chosen star (or the first one).

aria.when: From label on the group; each star is named "N stars".
Read-only ratings, named "Label: Rated 4.5 out of 5".

accessibility.focus: A focus ring appears around the focused star.

wcag.how: Read-only stars have a text summary of the score.
Native radio inputs: Tab to the group, arrows to change.
A named radio group whose checked star is the value.

notes: Filled and empty stars differ in shape fill as well as color.

examples.title: Rate something
examples.code:
import { Rating } from '@ds/react';

<Rating label="Rate this template" value={score} onValueChange={setScore} />

examples.title: Average score
examples.description: Read-only, with a half star and the number.
examples.code:
import { Rating } from '@ds/react';

<Rating label="Customer rating" value={4.5} readOnly showValue size="small" />

examples.title: Translated
examples.code:
import { Rating } from '@ds/react';

<Rating label="قيّم القالب" starLabel={(n) => `${n} من 5`} />

related.relation: Use for scores that need words, e.g. "Poor" to "Great".
Use for a wide numeric range.

components.name: Rating
components.description:
Stars for giving or showing a rating. Interactive ratings are a radio group (arrow keys move
between scores); read-only ratings are a single image with a spoken summary.

label.description: What is rated, e.g. "Rate this template". Names the group.

value.description: Rating shown (controlled). 0 means not rated. Halves show in read-only mode.

readOnly.description: Shows a rating without letting people change it, e.g. an average of 4.5.

size.description: `small` in lists and cards, `medium` (default), `large` for a rating form.

showValue.description: Shows the number after the stars, e.g. "4.5".

starLabel.description: Words for each star, for translation. Default "1 star", "2 stars"…

summaryLabel.description: Words for the read-only summary. Default "Rated 4.5 out of 5".

--rating-full-color.description: Tone-colored text directly on surfaces, e.g. text buttons and links.

--rating-empty-color.description: Outline of text fields, selects and comboboxes; the lightest gray with 3:1 contrast.

--rating-hover-color.description: Tone-colored text directly on surfaces, e.g. text buttons and links.

--rating-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--rating-value-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--rating-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--rating-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

--rating-focus-ring-color.description: Focus ring color; follows the brand accent.

--rating-focus-ring-radius.description: Small rounding for tiny elements: checkboxes, tags.
